source_distribution: Own actual fresh C0-shadow P0 prestate; treatment and on-policy extensions must be separately recorded
sampling: Use the frozen corpus_v2 chronological-first plus up to8 evenly spaced additional probes per class, including correct, wrong, no-positive, unavailable, competitive and observational propagation classes. Never select by branch effects.
runtime_plan: Frame and episode UID only, no GT identity/positive UID/future label fields
action_scope: One current action then own KEEP continuation. DELAYED_CHALLENGER executes KEEP at t and waits until t+2 for3 consecutive current/past learned proposals with feature cosine>=.9 and boxIoU>=.3, then at most one feasible action. All future state is branch-owned.
candidate_choice: Current raw-anchor cosine or current frozen joint candidate probabilities, deterministic UID tie break. Alternative excludes own KEEP UID; swap considers only currently competitor-owned UIDs. No offline positive UID enters action choice.
recovery_applicability: Own current KEEP is NONE or target state is LOST; otherwise record NOT_APPLICABLE, not a new action experiment
hard_solver_constraints: Original solve_counterfactual_global_assignment, no hard-negative relaxation or target-only splice
duplicate_action_configs: Retain actual branches but mark identical current action signatures; never count them as new independent events
future_definition: k=1..H inclusive. Current t correctness is separate. Incomplete future windows stay incomplete, never imputed as negative labels.
cache_contract: Capture current probabilities/features before running any future branch; frozen model may be shared, mutable tracker/bank/pending state may not
other_person_truth: Offline source-prefix public identity origins, excluding clicked-person fragments. Compare branch versus its paired own KEEP, not another run's future state.
scientific_scope: Counterfactual event supervision, not an adaptive deployable policy or whole-sequence HOTA result
